freeze: Before opening any South Saskatchewan CSV measurement rows

reference.measurement_members: All50 published CSV cross-sections, all3 years; no subset selected by results
reference.coordinate_interpretation: EPSG:32613 inferred from same-grant companion orthomosaic/DSM explicit CRS, not directly certified by ADCP metadata; geometry-fit check required
reference.velocity: Boat-motion-corrected ADCP horizontal depth-average components; not a terrain-derived flow label
reference.limitations: Grid-versus-true-north and positional error unreported; observed local current can differ from coarse routing, braid-branch or basin direction

geometry_phase.rule: Read ONLY columns0/1 to establish geometry extent and crop requests; velocity columns not parsed or emitted until predictors sealed
geometry_phase.domain: Whole coordinate envelope plus300m metric halo; fail if outside published broad bbox or >1000000 cells at30m
geometry_phase.predictor_inputs: GLO30 public COGs and MERIT-derived distributor basin71; metadata selection, never label performance
geometry_phase.dem: GLO30 bilinear onto projected metric30m and90m grids, fill and none, stream100000m2; no hydrographic label burning
geometry_phase.merit: Native3arcsecond categorical vectors, nearest native cell and projected downstream endpoint; mosaic71 preselected via source geography, no favorable replacement
geometry_phase.outlet: No anchor unless independently documented in a separate source before reference opening; absence blocks real outlet-gain claim

scoring.block_identity: year,floor(easting/180),floor(northing/180); fixed spatial tiling, not terrain-derived channels
scoring.block_vector: Arithmetic mean of eligible observed u/v, normalized for angles; coherence is magnitude of mean normalized point vectors
scoring.block_location: Mean eligible observed easting/northing, independent of terrain predictions
scoring.unknown: Nonfinite, slow and low-support/incoherent observations remain excluded/unknown with denominators; never negative labels
scoring.primary: Per-year angular error and positive-cosine hemisphere agreement of each source on identical eligible blocks
secondary: paired win/tie/loss of angle errors on common source support
scoring.position_stress: Four cardinal shifts at each nonzero displacement; not measured registration correction
scoring.claim: Conditional physical observed-flow agreement for one braided river surveyed3years, with unverified absolute registration/heading; not global accuracy, transfer, routing-error truth, exposure performance or outlet gain
scoring.statistics: No pixel-independent inferential tests/CI; years/cross-sections share one river and are correlated
scoring.no_fusion_gain: No claim of improved spectral/outlet fusion without matched observations and independently sourced anchors; symmetry tests separately establish directional identifiability limits
